Bennett]] |jpva=[[Houko Kuwashima]] }} |} '''Lucca''' (Japanese: '''ルッカ''' ''Lucca''), also referred to as '''Mrs. Lucca''' (Japanese: '''ルッカ先生''' ''Lucca-sensei''), is a supporting character who appears in {{aniseries|HZ}}. She is a {{tc|teacher}} and [[Liko]]'s [[mother]]. ==History== ===Pre-series=== Lucca grew up somewhere in the [[Kanto]] [[region]], where she met [[Alex]] when she attended [[Indigo Academy]]. Sometime before the events of ''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]'', Lucca met [[Friede]] and became his teacher. As revealed in ''[[HZ018|Flying Pikachu, Rising Higher and Higher!]]'', some years later, she moved to [[Paldea]] with Alex and eventually had her daughter named [[Liko]]. Lucca introduced Friede to [[Captain Pikachu]], which led them to forming the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]]. One day, Lucca was contacted by [[Diana|her mother]] as she asked her to hire anyone she trusted to protect both Liko and the pendant. Accepting her mother's request, Lucca called Friede and asked him to bring Liko, who was attending Indigo Academy, to Paldea and protect her during the journey there. ===''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]''=== [[File:Friede and Lucca.png|thumb|250px|left|Lucca and Friede]] Lucca was first mentioned in ''[[HZ001|The Pendant That Starts It All (Part One)]]'' by [[Liko]] when she talking to her roommate that she befriend named [[Ann]]. She and [[Alex|her husband]] recommended [[Indigo Academy]] as the place where Liko would attend in the hopes of finding her goal. In ''[[HZ003|For Sure! 'Cause Sprigatito's with Me!]]'', [[Friede]] mentioned her, where it was revealed that she asked and paid the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] to be Liko's bodyguards. In ''[[HZ009|Welcome to Paldea!]]'', she was mentioned by Alex, when Liko asked where she was and Alex told Liko that she was on a field trip and couldn't come home that day. In ''[[HZ011|Arboliva's Forest]]'', Friede mentioned that he was awaiting contact from her. Lucca made her first physical appearance in the [[HZ012|next episode]]. Meeting Friede in a library in [[Artazon]], Lucca told Friede the story about the [[Lucius|Ancient Adventurer]], and how the story was connected with the two [[Ancient Poké Ball]]s that Liko and [[Roy]] had. Friede also asked her if she knew anything about Liko's pendant since she was her mother, and she told him that she didn't know much about it, as it belonged to her mother, [[Diana]]. She also revealed that Diana had given the pendant to Liko as a good-luck charm. [[File:Liko and Lucca.png|thumb|250px|Lucca and Liko]] In ''[[HZ024|Reunion at the Ancient Castle!]]'', Diana revealed to Liko that she and Lucca had frequent contact about the journey Liko had been on with the Rising Volt Tacklers. Lucca met Liko again some time before the events of ''[[HZ046|Welcome to Naranja Academy!]]''. During the episode, Lucca and her husband welcomed Liko and prepared her to enter [[Naranja Academy]]. Lucca accompanied her during the way to the school, and when they separated, she wished Liko good luck. Lucca was mentioned in ''[[HZ074|The Three Explorers]]'' where Diana revealed that she met with her daughter and she revealed that Liko was traveling to [[Kitakami]] with the Rising Volt Tacklers. In ''[[HZ082|Beyond the Shining Rainbow]]'', Lucca and Alex received a message from Liko on her Rotom Phone informing her that Liko had made progress in her search for the [[Six Heroes]]. After seeing the message, she saw [[Black Rayquaza]] flying alongside the [[Brave Olivine]]. ==Character== Lucca is a caring mother, who doesn't want to let her maternal-side influence Liko, and prefers her daughter to do things on her own as a way to have her learn about herself. According to her daughter, Lucca has a really short temper, just like her [[Diana|mother]] and [[Rystal|great-grandmother]], as revealed in [[HZ074|''The Three Explorers'']]. ==Pokémon== ===Traveling with=== {| width="75%" | {{ActivePoké|||nick=Rotom Phone|Lucca Rotom Phone.png|electric|ghost|link=Rotom Phone}} | |} ===Temporary=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Diana |pkmn=Squawkabilly |type1=Normal |type2=Flying |img=Lucca Squawkabilly.png |epnum=HZ012 |epname=The Future I Choose |vajp=Tatsuki Kobe |vaen=Marc Thompson |desc=In ''[[HZ012|The Future I Choose]]'', [[Diana]]'s {{p|Squawkabilly}} was seen with Lucca.
